key_caveats: Jurisdiction splits the cluster in half: 25 of 50 localities sit inside Greater Chennai Corporation limits and 25 sit in Tambaram City Municipal Corporation or in Chengalpattu and Kanchipuram district panchayats. The GCC pet-licence portal, free microchipping, the Rs 5,000 penalty from 16 June 2026 and the GCC free pet clinics do not reach the outer 25 localities, so the licence-compliance wedge that the spine report treats as the acquisition engine is available in only 25 of the 50 addresses in this dataset.

Only one GCC free pet clinic and ABC centre sits inside the cluster at all: Meenambakkam, No.53/28 B Nehru High Road, B V Nagar, Nanganallur 600061, open 8:00 to 15:00. The other five free pet clinics and four of the five ABC centres are 12 to 20 km north of the Zone A footprint.

Household and demand figures are tier C throughout. No ward-level Census 2011 household table was retrievable for the post-2021 200-ward GCC structure, so the household base is a modelled footprint times archetype density, calibrated so the cluster total reconciles to roughly 1.03 million people over 100.7 km2.

Affluence uses the MagicBricks median Rs per sq ft of the listed flats for the locality, with propspedia as a cross-check. propspedia samples are 1 to 17 listings and MagicBricks samples 14 to 39, so both are noisy. Pammal at Rs 7,500 on the MagicBricks median against Rs 25,050 on propspedia is the widest gap in the set.

The competition picture is a floor, not a census. Justdial served full listing data for only its first three requests per address before soft-blocking, and Gully Tails indexes 284 Chennai clinics of which one page loaded. Twenty-four of the 50 localities returned no named operator, which means "not found in the sources that loaded", not confirmed absence.

Rent per sq ft was not found on any site that loaded. The affluence axis therefore rests entirely on sale prices, which biases the cluster towards owner-occupied and understates renter-constrained localities.

The Parandur airport corridor is 52.6 km straight line from the hub with a published inventory of 9-plus properties at Rs 6.1 lakh to Rs 27 lakh and an average of Rs 2,469 per sq ft. It is a pre-build land market, not a completed community, and it is not a drivable daily route from Velachery.

Total addressable our-mix revenue for the whole cluster is Rs 2198,015 a month against a total market of Rs 5089,043. One route carries 156 visits, so the cluster is far larger than one route but far smaller than a citywide service, which is exactly the shape the spine report's two-or-three-contiguous-micro-zone instruction assumes.
